verdict.rationale: Radar Pro explicitly extends beyond checkout to detect 'multi-account, free trial, and pay-as-you-go abuse' (docs-16), and Radar Sessions can capture fraud signals outside pure payment tokenization (docs-15), showing some reach into account/promo abuse. However, there is no evidence of dedicated account-takeover scoring or that these abuse types are managed via the same rules/review/analytics workflow described for payments (docs-3, docs-11, docs-26) rather than a separate Radar Pro feature set. Missing for 10: explicit account-takeover detection capability, confirmation that abuse signals feed the same rule engine/review queue/analytics dashboard, and independent/community confirmation of these non-checkout use cases.
